description.content:
Create dynamic forms that add or change questions based on triggers in your website or app. For example, a purchase on your website would trigger an email with form questions related to the product purchased by the user. 

You would require mmAPI key, campaign id, form id to configure this API. Follow the help doc to get these details from your Mailmodo account. ( https://help.mailmodo.com/en/articles/146-how-to-get-the-mmapi-key-form-id-and-campaign-id )
